manuscript_title: Temperature Drift at the heated chamber

evidence.quote: Under steady conditions, the sensor measured 14 K at the heated chamber.

rows.target: 稳态条件下，传感器的读数为 14 K。

evidence.quote: The reference sensor recorded 20 K at the heated chamber.

rows.target: 参考传感器在同一地点测得 20 K。

evidence.quote: Only the steady condition was observed; the temperature drift outside that condition was not measured.

rows.target: 仅观测了稳态条件，其他条件下的温度漂移没有测量。
